notes:
- New map: St. Mercy Hospital (open from the start). A Main Lobby with a reception desk and waiting
  chairs, corridors, an Operating Theatre with an observation gallery and a surgical lamp, a Cafeteria and a
  Healing Garden, always in the same place. Around them, different every game: two-storey Patient Wards,
  the Emergency Room, Intensive Care, the Morgue (walls of body drawers), Radiology (a scanner), Medical
  Records and the chapel. Hospital beds with drip stands and curtains, its own cold green look, flickering
  lights, and survivors' messages on the walls.
- Hospital zombies: patients in gowns, nurses in scrubs and doctors in white coats.
- New zombie: the Screamer (in the hospital from round 3). A gaunt, deathly pale patient with red eyes.
  Every few seconds it throws its head back and shrieks, with a shockwave you can see, and every zombie
  near it sprints for 5 seconds. Kill it first.
